name: Meadowood Napa Valley
insider_take: This legendary Relais & Châteaux estate feels like your own private wine country manor, where golf greens meet vine rows and Michelin-starred dining unfolds under ancient oak trees.
whats_special: Meadowood sits on 250 pristine acres and features the only golf course designed specifically for a luxury resort in Napa Valley. The property is home to the prestigious Auction Napa Valley, the world's most celebrated charity wine auction, and boasts a three-Michelin-starred restaurant helmed by Christopher Kostow.
pro_tip: Book a private wine tasting in Meadowood's exclusive Wine Library, which houses rare vintages from over 200 Napa Valley producers—many bottles unavailable anywhere else.
dont_miss: The croquet lawns where you can play the sport that put Meadowood on the map (they host the US Croquet Championship), and sunrise hot air balloon rides departing directly from the resort grounds with champagne breakfast upon landing.
pros: World-class wine country location in prestigious Napa Valley
Luxury resort with championship golf course and spa facilities
Fine dining restaurant with wine country cuisine
Elegant accommodations with vineyard and mountain views
cons: Rural location requires transportation to nearby attractions
